text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Local Government Minister Gunnar Berge believes that the unemployment rate will drop below four percent next year.

- The state pollution agency wants to ban the dumping of old ships at sea because steel and other parts in the hulls can be recycled. No such ban however is proposed against dumping decommissioned oil platforms.
- Prime Minister Gro Harlem Brundtland says Norwegian industry has come to accept that the state has a role to play in private business.
- Sysdeco, the Norwegian software company, was not aware that Citco Global Custody was its main shareholder until the Morgan Grenfell affair came to light.
- Subsidised modems with an Internet subscription are selling like crazy.
